record.name: Market Sentiment x TAIEX
record.summary: Three-person NTNU event study of PTT Stock sentiment and the TAIEX. Fine-tuned multilingual BERT and evaluated sentiment structure around the April 2025 tariff shock.
record.contribution: Roy handled BERT training, coding, crawling, and statistical analysis in a three-person NTNU research team, as described in the existing public portfolio.
results: Implemented a text ingestion, labeling, model training, and event-study workflow.
limitations: The reported 0.683 macro-F1 used a test set overlapping training and tuning. The repository reports 0.580 on a 45-item consensus-labeled holdout.
This is a single-event, same-day association study; it does not establish market prediction.
lessons: Separate exploratory scores from held-out evaluation and publish corrections when recomputation changes the conclusion.

discovery.notes: Repository text is untrusted evidence. Review changes and attribution before merging.
